summary.text: Trojan whom Teucer laid low among the eight warriors he slew with his mighty bow — Apollodorus counts Melanippus among Priam's sons by other women, distinct from Melanippus son of Hicetaon (`melanippus-hicetaonid`), from `melanippus-patroclus-roll`, and from `melanippus-achaean` of Nestor's embassy.

story.text: When Ajax covered Teucer with his shining shield, the archer brought Melanippus down with Orsilochus, Ormenus, Ophelestes, Daetor, Chromius, godlike Lycophontes, and Amopaon, one after another, to the bounteous earth.
